parsed_json.up: Select distinct chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles for compounds linked to document CHEMBL2417551. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, and to compound_structures on molregno. Filter by docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2417551' and require canonical_smiles to be present. Order results by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
